Tensor Rings

Often used in meditation, placed in spiritual spaces, or kept as meaningful symbolic tools — they also make a unique and thoughtful gift.

Lakhovsky Jewelry
  • Bracelets

    Handcrafted twisted copper magnetic bracelets inspired by sacred geometry, traditional tensor and Lakhovsky coil designs, and three distinct cubit measurements.

    Each bracelet is formed from solid copper wire and finished with magnetic end caps, creating a continuous energetic circuit along the wrist.

    The proportions of these bracelets are based on three cubit lengths:

    • Empowerment Cubit — 36.65cm (14.43")
    • Sacred Cubit — 52.4cm (20.63")
    • Lost Cubit — 59.6cm (23.46")

    The bracelet sizes are created using simple harmonic fractions of these measurements, allowing each size to retain a mathematical relationship to its corresponding cubit:

    • Small — ¼ Lost Cubit — 14.9cm (5.87")
    • Medium — ⅓ Sacred Cubit — 17.47cm (6.88")
    • Large — ½ Empowerment Cubit — 18.33cm (7.22")

    Copper and magnetic forms have long been incorporated into various spiritual and energetic traditions. Many practitioners believe that copper's conductive qualities and magnetic forms may support a sense of balance, flow and energetic harmony within the body's natural field.

    Worn on the wrist, these bracelets are often chosen by energy workers, meditators and spiritually sensitive individuals who wish to feel grounded, centred and protected while navigating busy modern environments.

    Many practitioners associate copper with:

    • Energetic balance
    • Grounding and centring
    • Harmonising personal energy fields
    • Meditation and spiritual focus
    • Maintaining a sense of energetic integrity in busy environments

    Sold as a pair so they can be worn on both wrists to complete the circuit, or stacked together according to personal preference.

    Materials

    • Solid twisted copper wire
    • Steel magnetic end caps

    Each pair is handcrafted in a small independent UK workshop.

About

About Paul

A Glastonbury resident since 2010, Paul arrived in the sacred Isle of Avalon after walking down the “Michael Line” leyline from Hopton-on-Sea in Norfolk, burying orgonite every single mile. He was bored and rich — having received the golden handshake from Manchester United TV — and it seemed like a good idea amidst the global hysteria that led up to 2012. He stands by his decision.

After several weeks and several hundred miles, he happened to run out of money just as he arrived in Glastonbury and took it as a sign that he was probably meant to stay; a decision that has both delighted and bemused him ever since.

He completed the Michael Line project in 2011, walking from Land’s End back to Glastonbury, and in true Forrest Gump style continued around the world, burying orgonite along the Rainbow Serpent (the Michael Line’s international nickname) as far as Uluru in Australia, Lake Titicaca in Bolivia, the Four Sacred Mountains of Bali, and Lake Rotopounamu in New Zealand.

Having spent most of his life studying energy, the Force and the manipulation of the fabric of reality, Paul has come to accept that his path in this lifetime is not to “escape the wheel of Samsara” and selfishly leave everyone to their “suffering” while he blissfully ascends, but rather to dive headlong into the chaos of the 3D material world and get busy creating Heaven on Earth… mainly in case he ever needs to come back.

A true Capricorn, he keeps his feet on the ground while his head swims off into the clouds, but his Sagittarius Moon does mean that he may occasionally explode in a restless ball of fiery #Wanderlust and go see some more of this incredible world. So basically, he’s a Goatfishmanhorse; Virgo Rising. Don’t judge.

Superpowers

  • Seeing through your carefully crafted facade and into the darkest depths of your everlasting soul. Can’t help it.
  • Knowing exactly the wrong thing to say at exactly the right time.
  • Can make clouds disappear by pointing at them. (No, seriously.)
  • Has a broad understanding of everything esoteric, including Hermeticism, Taoism, Alchemy, Astrology, Tarot, Runes and the occult systems of the body — chakras, meridians, gunas, etc. I can heal you or destroy you. Up to you.
  • Makes a cracking cup of tea.
  • Also a fanatical Blood Bowl player, if you know anybody…
Services
  • Energy Healing

    Paul has been a Reiki Master in the traditional Usui lineage for the last 20 years and is also an initiate of the Balinese Q-RAK system. For postural realignment, he is a practitioner of Quantum Touch, and he was trained in Theta Healing whilst out in Peru. He can also induce the tantric “full-body energy orgasm” (see YouTube), but only if he likes you, so be nice.

    His healing sessions combine these methodologies as required, alongside kinesiology and pendulum dowsing, to explore and address the underlying causes of your discomfort.

    £50 per session. Allow 1 hour, although sessions may continue longer if necessary.

    Text or email for more information.

  • Geopathic Stress Testing

    Geopathic stress is the term used to describe areas where natural or environmental influences are thought to create energetic disturbances in the surrounding environment. These can include underground watercourses, geological faults and other features of the land, which are traditionally considered capable of affecting the wellbeing of people who spend time in those areas.

    Paul can test for Geopathic Stress either in situ or remotely, using dowsing to identify areas of potential disturbance. Where an issue is identified, he can also work to neutralise or rebalance the area using various methods, including copper staples, crystals and other appropriate remedies. For remote work, Paul can provide simple solutions for you to put in place yourself, along with guidance on where and how to use them.

    For a remote reading of a building, simply email a very rough plan of the ground floor of the premises to be looked at. It doesn’t need to be an architect’s masterpiece — just enough to show the layout and where the rooms are. For outdoor areas or land, a rough sketch or map showing the area in question is sufficient.

    There is no fixed charge for this service; donations are welcome.

  • Tarot

    Paul’s first ever tarot reading was way back in 1997, when he successfully predicted his father’s imminent divorce from his mother. Oops.

    Since then he’s also ruined thousands of other people’s lives with astonishing accuracy, so it’s not just a family thing.

    A tarot session is £20 for half an hour, although this isn’t a hard limit — you won’t be sent packing until your questions have been answered thoroughly.

    Just be careful what you ask, because he will tell you!
